name: CommentCategoryDataModel

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for comment or category record

fields.name: type
fields.description: Record type: 'comment' or 'category'

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to associated ticket (for comments only)

fields.name: content
fields.description: Comment text or category name with description

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: User or agent ID who created the comment or category

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Parent comment ID for threaded conversations or parent category for hierarchy

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Additional data: SLA rules for categories, knowledge base references, visibility flags, attachments

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when comment was posted or category was created

indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order
Support efficient querying of categories and threaded comments

constraints.validParentReference: parentId must reference existing record of same type

description: Stores ticket comments with threaded conversations and ticket categories with SLA rules for help desk ticketing system

relationships.description: Comments and categories are created by users or agents

name: TicketDataModel

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (open, in-progress, resolved, closed)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (low, medium, high, critical)

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: ID of the agent assigned to handle the ticket

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was created

fields.name: slaDueDate
fields.description: Service Level Agreement deadline for ticket resolution

fields.name: requesterId
fields.description: ID of the user who submitted the ticket

description: Central data model for managing help desk tickets including status, priority, assignment, and SLA tracking

name: UserAgentDataModel

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the user or agent

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for contact and authentication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role in the system (customer, agent, team_lead, administrator)

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department or team assignment for agents

fields.name: isAvailable
fields.description: Current availability status for agents to handle tickets

fields.name: activeTicketCount
fields.description: Number of tickets currently assigned to the agent

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.role: Must be one of: customer, agent, team_lead, administrator

description: Manages user profiles, agent information, roles, and team assignments for the help desk ticketing system

relationships.description: An agent can be assigned to multiple tickets
